final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed_amount, r.avg_balance, 1.0 * r.avg_signed_amount / o.avg_signed_amount FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_signed_amount IS NOT NULL
